device.batteryChargingHint: The Myo only reports its level, so charging is estimated from the level rising. It can't be detected at a full battery.

errors.desktopOnly: This needs the desktop app. It isn't available in a regular browser.

errors.bluetoothUnavailable: Bluetooth isn't available. Check that it's on and that Galvani is allowed in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Bluetooth.
errors.permissionDenied: Galvani isn't allowed to use Bluetooth. Allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Bluetooth.

errors.connectionTimedOut: The connection timed out. Make sure the Myo is nearby and awake, then try again.
errors.notAMyo: This device doesn't behave like a Myo.
errors.bluetoothError: The Bluetooth connection failed. The app log has more details.
errors.profileNotSaved: The placement and calibration couldn't be saved.
errors.recordingFailed: The recording failed. The app log has more details.
errors.notRecording: There is no recording in progress.
errors.alreadyRecording: A recording is already in progress.

privacyNotice: sEMG data can identify a person. Don't share recordings without consent.

placement.title: Placement
placement.lineHint: The blue line is the light strip beside the Thalmic logo.
placement.armMismatch: The Myo detected the {{arm}} arm, which differs from your choice. Galvani keeps using your choice. If it's correct, repeat the Myo's sync gesture.
placement.placementChanged: The placement changed after calibrating. Calibrate again.
placement.armHint: Galvani uses your choice here. The Myo also detects an arm by itself when it syncs, shown under Gestures, and that detection can be wrong.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.intro: This takes a few minutes. Galvani guides you through six simple positions, one at a time: you start each one, then accept it or repeat it. They measure your signal levels, how the armband sits on your forearm, and a reference posture. Only summary values are saved on this Mac, not recordings.
calibration.safety: Use a firm effort without straining, and stop if anything hurts.
calibration.failed: The calibration stopped because the signal was interrupted. Check the connection and try again.
calibration.review: The calibration finished, but check these points. You can repeat it or save it anyway.

warnings.weakSignal: The fist barely rose above the resting level on at least one channel. Check that the armband fits snugly, or repeat with a firmer fist.
warnings.wavesNotDistinct: Both wrist gestures peaked on the same channel. Check the armband's fit and repeat them.
warnings.armNotHanging: The arm didn't seem to hang straight down during that step.
warnings.armMoved: The arm didn't seem level during the forward step.
warnings.lineMismatch: Gravity shows the blue line pointing the other way. Check how you're wearing the armband, or change the setting under Placement.

rest.title: Rest
rest.instruction: Relax your arm on your lap or a table, and keep your hand loose.

fist.title: Firm fist
fist.instruction: Close your hand into a firm fist and hold it. Relax between repetitions.

waveIn.title: Wave in
waveIn.instruction: Bend your wrist toward your palm and hold it.

waveOut.title: Wave out
waveOut.instruction: Bend your wrist toward the back of your hand and hold it.

hang.title: Arm hanging
hang.instruction: Stand or sit upright, and let your arm hang straight down, relaxed.

forward.title: Arm forward
forward.instruction: Extend your arm straight ahead at shoulder height, palm down, and hold still.

calibration.notEnoughData: Too little signal arrived during this step. Check the connection and repeat it.

views.label: Views
views.empty: Connect a device to see this view.

activation.mapHint: Calibrate to place the back of the forearm at the top. The channel order follows the band, and the drawing is schematic.
activation.mapHintCalibrated: {{channel}}, the strongest in wave out, is at the top. The channel order follows the band, and the drawing is schematic.
activation.scaleCalibrated: 100% is your calibrated fist on each channel, and 0% is your resting level.
activation.scaleFixed: Calibrate to scale this to your own signal. For now, 100% is a fixed reference.

motion.title: Orientation
motion.hint: Calibrate, or use the button, to choose the posture shown as zero. The view is from behind your arm, and the trail shows where it has pointed. The model is schematic.
motion.hintCalibrated: Zero is your calibrated arm-forward posture, until you change it with the button. The view is from behind your arm, and the trail shows where it has pointed. The model is schematic.

control.syncFailed: The sync gesture failed. Try it again, more gently.
control.syncHint: The Myo detects the arm and starts reporting gestures after its sync gesture. Wear it for a moment to warm up, then bend your wrist outward and hold it. While locked, it may not report gestures.
control.patternHint: Drag the top of a bar to set its strength, and its right edge to set its duration.
control.modesHint: Views stop updating for any data you turn off.
control.sleepWarning: In this mode the Myo may disconnect after a period of inactivity.
control.deepSleepTitle: Put the Myo into deep sleep?
control.deepSleepWarning: This ends the session and the Myo stops responding to Bluetooth. Waking it may require connecting it by USB, and Galvani can't wake it.
control.ledsHint: This command is undocumented and comes from pyomyo, so it may not work on every armband, or may stop applying after a while.

recordings.needsDevice: Connect a device to record. Galvani can record while its window is closed.
recordings.backgroundHint: Recording continues in the background if you close the window.
recordings.name: Name
recordings.statsHint: Each recording is a folder with CSV files and its metadata in JSON. Lost samples are estimated against the nominal 200 Hz. Latency can't be measured, because the Myo sends no timestamps.

training.empty: Add the gestures you want Galvani to recognize, then train each one.
training.needsDevice: Connect a device to train gestures.
training.instruction: Hold "{{name}}" steadily during the countdown, and relax between repetitions.
training.liveEmpty: Train at least one gesture and connect a device to see its recognition here.
training.confusionCaption: Each row is the gesture performed, and each column what was recognized.
training.evaluationHint: Measured by testing each repetition with a model trained on the others. This is an estimate for the armband staying in place: moving it may need training again.
training.evaluationEmpty: Train at least two gestures to see the expected accuracy.
